scope: Read-only review of the supplied WP06-S02-T02 follow-up snapshot (CapturedOperationContext.cs, ProviderStateCapture.cs, microsoft-provider-operation.md, microsoft-provider-scopes.md). I used no tools and ran nothing. Test results are the developer's report and I have not checked them myself.

optionalFindings.detail: Formatting only. There is no blank line between Capture and NormalizeOperationId, and there is a stray blank line before the closing class brace. Every other member pair in the file is separated by one blank line.

Optional clarity. The guard `++visited > LogValueProjection.MaximumNodes` is the root scan guard that the docs call the '1024-entry work guard'. It reuses the node constant. A short comment, or a named local such as `MaximumRootEntries = LogValueProjection.MaximumNodes`, would make the doc-to-code link explicit. No behavior change is needed.

Keep the failed initial Developer run (9 OperationScopeFoundation failures on the paramName change) in the receipt as historical evidence, as planned. The pass claim currently rests on the focused 47-test run (35 existing + 12 new). It should be upgraded only after the full 5217-test run and the native reader results are recorded.

confirmations: The old typed behavior is preserved. Capture passes nameof(context), so ArgumentException.ParamName stays 'context' for the 9 foundation tests. The structured scope path passes 'state'. Trim, blank-to-null and the 255-scalar/no-control validation are shared through the single NormalizeOperationId helper, which uses one message string (O6).

Recognized CLR string IDs are handled before the remaining==0 check. They can therefore be read after the value budget is full, but only within the visited guard. Entries past the guard set truncated and break, which matches the visited-prefix/unvisited-tail wording (O4).

Duplicate semantics match the docs. A later string removes the earlier ordinary attribute and sets or clears the ID. A blank string clears the frame ID. A later non-string nulls the ID and falls through to the ordinary budget. Removed values are not refunded (O2/O3).

LogValue.String and other non-string values, differently cased keys, and event-mode operation_id all remain ordinary attributes. Event mode never enters the recognition branch because of !includeEventId.

Owned scopes rethrow the normalization ArgumentException before frame creation. Borrowed frames rely on the existing ArgumentException-to-omitted-frame path, which is consistent with microsoft-provider-scopes.md.
The O5 grammar/duplicate qualification text reads correctly. The two docs cross-reference each other consistently.
